headline: **MLB Daily Roundup: July 9, 2026**
article:
The Toronto Blue Jays dominated the San Francisco Giants with a 10-0 victory, led by Kazuma Okamoto's 2 hits, 1 home run, and 4 RBIs. The Chicago Cubs secured a thrilling 9-7 win against the Baltimore Orioles, with Pete Crow-Armstrong hitting 2 home runs and driving in 2 runs. The Detroit Tigers took down the Athletics 6-1, thanks to Spencer Torkelson's 15th home run of the season and Troy Melton's 5.1 scoreless innings of relief.

Several key players have been placed on the injured list, including Ranger Suarez (left groin strain) and Connor Prielipp (left middle finger blister), both of whom will miss time for their respective teams. Additionally, Samad Taylor (right oblique strain), Marco Raya (right shoulder impingement), Endy Rodríguez (left glute strain), Lou Trivino III (right thoracic muscle spasm), Jonah Cox (left oblique strain), and Austin Warren (right forearm strain) have all been sidelined.

The New York Mets made a trade with the Detroit Tigers, acquiring right-handed pitcher Matt Seelinger for cash considerations. The Minnesota Twins also made a trade, acquiring right-handed pitcher Woo-Suk Go from the Detroit Tigers for cash. The Cleveland Guardians acquired right-handed pitcher Ryan Degges from the Philadelphia Phillies in a separate trade, while the Washington Nationals acquired left-handed pitcher Tom Cosgrove from the Houston Astros.

top_news.title: **Blue Jays Shut Out Giants 10-0**
top_news.summary: The Toronto Blue Jays dominated the San Francisco Giants, securing a 10-0 victory. Kazuma Okamoto led the Blue Jays' offense with 2 hits, 1 home run, and 4 RBIs.

top_news.title: **Cubs Take Down Orioles in Thrilling 9-7 Victory**
top_news.summary: The Chicago Cubs secured a hard-fought win against the Baltimore Orioles, outscoring them 9-7. Pete Crow-Armstrong led the Cubs' offense with a standout performance, hitting 2 home runs and driving in 2 runs.

top_news.title: **Torkelson Powers Tigers Past Athletics**
top_news.summary: Spencer Torkelson hit a 15th home run of the season, a three-run shot to left field, leading the Detroit Tigers to a 6-1 victory over the Athletics. Troy Melton earned the win with 5.1 innings of scoreless relief, striking out nine batters.

top_news.title: **Braves Shut Out Pirates 3-0**
top_news.summary: The Atlanta Braves secured a shutout victory over the Pittsburgh Pirates, with Dylan Dodd earning the win. Joey Bart led the Braves' offense with a home run and two RBIs.

top_news.title: **Red Sox Place Ranger Suarez on Injured List**
top_news.summary: Boston Red Sox left-handed pitcher Ranger Suarez has been placed on the 15-day injured list due to a left groin strain, effective retroactive to July 6, 2026.

top_news.title: **Mets Acquire RHP Matt Seelinger in Trade**
top_news.summary: The New York Mets have acquired right-handed pitcher Matt Seelinger in a trade with the Detroit Tigers. The deal was made for cash considerations.
